NCAAF News

  • Georgia State football coach Shawn Elliott agrees to a three-year contract extension

    Georgia State coach Shawn Elliott has agreed to a three-year contract extension through the 2024 season.

  • Insurance broker offers COVID-19 health coverage for college athletics

    The insurance potentially covers some 450,000 athletes at more than 1,200 NCAA schools, although it's unknown how many will purchase the policy.

  • Lott Trophy for outstanding defensive player expands field to six

    The Lott IMPACT Trophy field will have six finalists and will be presented in February, changes instituted because of the coronavirus.

  • Purdue star receiver Rondale Moore won't play in Saturday's football game against Iowa

    Purdue star receiver Rondale Moore, who opted back in to play this season, won't play against the Hawkeyes.

  • Army-Navy game will be played at West Point for first time since World War II

    West Point will host the 121st Army-Navy game on Dec. 12 instead of it being played in Philadelphia as planned, because of attendance limits in the state of Pennsylvania during the coronavirus pandemic.

  • College football Week 8 betting nuggets

    Here are numbers you can use for 16 of this week's biggest games, plus a warning about wagering on the top five teams in the country.
